name: dataforseo/v3/ai_optimization/llm_mentions/top_mentioned_brands/live
description: The brands most often mentioned in AI answers that match a keyword or domain, with mention counts and AI search volume.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

target.description: Array of up to 10 entities, each with one `domain` or one `keyword` (optional `search_filter`, `search_scope`, `match_type`).

platform.description: Optional: "google" (AI Overviews) or "chat_gpt". Omit for both.

input_schema.description: Request parameters forwarded to DataForSEO /v3/ai_optimization/llm_mentions/top_mentioned_brands/live. See DataForSEO docs for full schema.

pricing.note: Billed per call from metered usage; the reference price is typical.
